command: set -e; SDK="${ANDROID_SDK_ROOT:-${ANDROID_HOME:-$HOME/Library/Android/sdk}}"; ADB="$SDK/platform-tools/adb"; SERIAL=RFCT70L7E8J; PACKAGE=link.localclimate.app; DUMP="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys package "$PACKAGE" | tr -d '\r')"; printf '%s\n' "$DUMP" | grep -q 'versionName=2.0.10'; printf '%s\n' "$DUMP" | grep -q 'versionCode=20010'; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am force-stop "$PACKAGE"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" logcat -c; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell am start -W -n "$PACKAGE/.MainActivity"; sleep 3; PID="$("$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell pidof "$PACKAGE" | tr -d '\r')"; test -n "$PID"; "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" shell dumpsys activity activities | grep -m1 'mResumedActivity' | grep "$PACKAGE"; if "$ADB" -s "$SERIAL" logcat -d --pid="$PID" -v brief | grep -E 'FATAL EXCEPTION|AndroidRuntime:.*FATAL|Process: link.localclimate.app.*has died'; then echo 'phone smoke found fatal process error' >&2; exit 1; fi; echo PHONE_SMOKE_PID=$PID
